text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Hey~, how far are we going~?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Not knowing where we're going is exciting 
and all, but Maya at least wants a hint~!

One day, upon request, I brought Mayano 
Top Gun out into the city.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Come on~, a hint! If you don't give me 
one, Maya's not taking another step~?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Huh, this place is――

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: We're glad you could come, Mayano-kun.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Here we go, everyone. ――On three!

text_block_list.name: Hayahide & Others
text_block_list.text: Happy Surprise!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Ehhhh~?! What's all this about, everyone?!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... Welcome, Mayano-kun, to our 
surprise party.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
We planned this to thank you for helping 
us out in various ways on a daily basis. 
We hope you enjoy it.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
That yakisoba pan back then was delicious. 
It energized me, and my times improved 
afterwards.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much for helping Hayahide!! 
The live was a huge success, and it was so 
much fun!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...Leaving a debt unpaid just doesn't sit 
right with me.

text_block_list.name: Mayano's Fans
text_block_list.text:
We became huge fans of Maya-chan after 
that live! So we were allowed to help 
prepare the party~!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Everyone here is someone who gained energy 
from receiving a present from you.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Much like Santa Claus at Christmas, you 
gave wonderful presents to those of us in 
distress.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
We wanted to return the warmth that you 
shared with us. And so――

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Today, we would like to give our Santa a 
present in return to say thank you.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: A thank-you present... for Santa? Ah...—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
(I remember now... Long ago, I wrote a 
letter to Santa...)

text_block_list.name: Young Mayano
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you for always giving me presents. 
As a thank-you, Maya is giving you a 
present this year."

text_block_list.name: Young Mayano
text_block_list.text: "To Maya's favorite Santa—Papa."

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
(The next day, Papa was wearing the scarf 
I gave to Santa, smiling all shyly and 
happy.)

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
(Was Papa feeling this exact same way back 
then...?)

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, I'm so happy to get a return 
present from everyone!♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
You know what, you know what?! Maya is... 
totally bursting with excitement!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Presents are so wonderful! Because—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
The person who gives it, and the person 
who gets it, both get to feel so super 
sparkly inside!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Oguri-san, Hayahide-san, Trainer, and 
everyone else, thank you!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Today, Maya is gonna give a present to 
Maya's Santa too!
That night—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, I took a whole bunch of cute 
pictures♪ I wonder if Papa will like 
them...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"To Papa. Today, I got a 'special present 
for a special day'—"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"From everyone special to me. To my 
beloved Papa, from Maya."
